subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Which one of the following systems is a causal 
system? (here u is input) 
 
 (a) y(t) = sin(u(t + 3)) 
 
(b) y(t) = 5u(t) + 3u(t – 1) 
 
(c) y(t) = 5u(t) + 3u(t + 1) 
 
(d) y(t) = sin(u(t – 3)) + sin(u(t + 3)) 
Common Data For 7 to 8 
 
Two discrete-time system S1 & S2 are connected in 
cascade to form a new system S as shown is figure
